ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has a circle with O as the center, A is on the left side of the circle, A, O, P are on the same horizontal straight line, and P is outside the circle on the right side. T is on the circle, and line PT is tangent to the circle at point T. Line segment AT intersects ray PB from P at B, and the angle markings in the figure show that PB is the angle bisector of ∠TPA. Reasoning: Let ∠TPA = 2x. Because PB bisects ∠TPA, ∠BPA = x. Since PT is a tangent to circle O, OT is the radius to the point of tangency, so OT ⟂ PT. In right triangle OPT, ∠OPT = ∠TPA = 2x, therefore ∠TOP = 90° - 2x. Also because OA and OP are on the same straight line and in opposite directions, ∠AOT = 180° - ∠TOP = 180° - (90° - 2x) = 90° + 2x. In triangle AOT, OA = OT, so it is an isosceles triangle, hence ∠OAT = ∠ATO = (180° - (90° + 2x)) / 2 = 45° - x. Since AP and AO are on the same straight line, ∠TAP = 45° - x. At point B, BT is along the direction of AT, while the angle between BP and AP is x, therefore ∠TBP = ∠TAP + x = (45° - x) + x = 45°.

raw_record.question_text: $PT$ is the tangent to a circle $O$, and $PB$ is the angle bisector of the angle $TPA$ (see diagram). How big is the angle $TBP$?

method.method_draft: From the diagram, read that A, O, P are collinear with A on the circle and O the center; T is the tangency point on the circle; B is the intersection of chord/segment AT with the angle-bisector ray PB. From the text, use that PT is tangent and PB bisects angle TPA. Let ∠TPA = 2x, so ∠BPA = x. Since OP is the same line as AP and OT is a radius to the tangent point, OT ⟂ PT, so in right triangle OPT the angle ∠TOP = 90° − 2x. Because OA is the opposite ray to OP, ∠AOT = 180° − ∠TOP = 90° + 2x. In isosceles triangle AOT, OA = OT, hence ∠OAT = ∠ATO = (180° − (90° + 2x))/2 = 45° − x. Since AP is the same line as AO, ∠TAP = 45° − x. At B, ray BT lies along AT, while ray BP makes angle x with the line AP because PB is the bisector. Therefore ∠TBP = ∠TAP + x = 45°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个以 O 为圆心的圆，A 在圆的左侧，A、O、P 在同一条水平直线上，P 在圆外右侧。T 在圆上，直线 PT 与圆在 T 点相切。线段 AT 与从 P 发出的射线 PB 相交于 B，图中角标显示 PB 是 ∠TPA 的角平分线。

推理：设 ∠TPA = 2x。因为 PB 平分 ∠TPA，所以 ∠BPA = x。由于 PT 是圆 O 的切线，OT 是切点半径，所以 OT ⟂ PT。在直角三角形 OPT 中，∠OPT = ∠TPA = 2x，因此 ∠TOP = 90° - 2x。又因为 OA 与 OP 在同一直线上且方向相反，所以 ∠AOT = 180° - ∠TOP = 180° - (90° - 2x) = 90° + 2x。三角形 AOT 中 OA = OT，故它是等腰三角形，所以 ∠OAT = ∠ATO = (180° - (90° + 2x)) / 2 = 45° - x。由于 AP 与 AO 在同一直线上，∠TAP = 45° - x。点 B 处，BT 沿着 AT 方向，而 BP 与 AP 的夹角为 x，因此 ∠TBP = ∠TAP + x = (45° - x) + x = 45°。
